author: Dario Barresi
method: Front-most scanned triangle depth and barycentrically interpolated original atlas UV sampled on a 97x97 XY lattice. Depth uses millimeters; atlas UV uses 65535 units per 1.0. Missing outline samples extrapolated. The core uses the original scan material/maps through these UVs; relief and placement are synthetic, not a Yosemite survey.
